_doc: FlashVSR thrash alert thresholds. Each signal maps to 0..1 linearly between its 'start' (0) and 'full' (1) value; the score is the weighted sum (weights sum to 1). Alert state 'thrash' when score >= thrash_at, 'near' when >= near_at. Delete this file to fall back to the built-in defaults in thrash_alert.py.
